title: Agent Skills launches AI coding pack with 24 smart dev #agentskills #aicode #softwaredevelopment
description: Agent Skills launched a pack of 24 AI-powered coding skills designed by a former Google AI engineering director. The tool automates the entire software development cycle — from planning to coding, testing, and pre-launch reviews — using best practices from Google. These skills independently activate at the right moments, translating ideas into detailed plans with clear tasks and checkpoints. By running real-time tests and senior-level reviews before release, it ensures production-ready, reliable applications that reduce the risk of breaking at launch. This innovation brings the expertise of senior engineers to developers of all levels, streamlining workflows and accelerating app delivery with high-quality standards. #AgentSkills #AIcoding #GoogleAI #SoftwareDevelopment #Automation #CodingSkills #DevTools #AIengineering #SoftwareTesting #TechInnovation #GitHubStars #AIinTech #AppDevelopment #CodeAutomation #DeveloperTools
